name: Dreamers
source:
Snake is a night club singer till one evening after have a strange nightmare she and her friend Jack are suck through a mirror into an other world. Jack and Snake get separated and while Jack gets sent to paradise, Snake gets sent on a wild adventure. On her journey she meets and teams-up with the sweet android Gale, the hot tempered Firefly, and the cowardly Bunny. Together the girls must defeat the evil Narcissus, Mistress Tentacle, and Wu. Can the girl stop fighting long enough to get the villains before they get them?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040708151729/http://www.chibialex.com/kami/kami-dream.html]chibialex.com[/url]]
translation:
Snake是一名夜总会歌手，直到有一天晚上，在做了一场奇怪的噩梦后，她和她的朋友Jack被镜子吸入了另一个世界。杰克和蛇分开了，杰克被送往天堂，而蛇则被送往疯狂的冒险。在旅途中，她遇到了可爱的机器人盖尔、脾气暴躁的萤火虫和胆怯的兔子，并与他们合作。女孩们必须齐心协力打败邪恶的水仙、触手女主人和吴。女孩能停止战斗足够长的时间，以便在恶棍抓住他们之前抓住他们吗？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040708151729/http://www.chibialex.com/kami/kami-dream.html]chibialex.com[/url]]
